jobs.title: Multiple IAM Developer's (KeyCloak)
jobs.description:
Gothenburg, Sweden | Onsite | 6–9-Month Contract | ASAP Start

Overview
We’re looking for 3 experienced Java Developers with strong hands-on Keycloak and Identity & Access Management experience to develop and support secure, scalable backend applications and authentication services.

This assignment combines Java backend development with identity security, working across microservices, API security and authentication integrations.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend applications and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
Configure, integrate and support Keycloak in production environments.
Implement authentication and authorisation using Spring Security, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and SAML.
Build secure REST APIs and integrate applications with identity services.
Implement and support single sign-on, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication and identity federation.
Troubleshoot application, authentication and integration issues across distributed systems.
Support containerised deployments and automated delivery using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

Key Experience Required
5+ years of commercial Java development experience, including Java 11/17+.
Strong experience with Spring Boot and Spring Security.
Significant hands-on Keycloak experience in production environments.
Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and SAML.
Experience developing secure REST APIs, microservices and distributed applications.
Practical knowledge of SSO, RBAC, MFA and identity federation.
Experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL.
Working knowledge of Git, Maven/Gradle, Docker and CI/CD.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Please attached UPDATED CV :)

jobs.title: Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer
jobs.description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise integrations and intelligent automations that enable business process transformation, operational efficiency, and digital innovation. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in APIs, integrations, robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation, and AI-enabled automation capabilities. The engineer partners closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to implement secure, reliable, and reusable solutions that connect applications, data, and business processes across the enterprise.

In this role, you will:

This role sits at the centre of Clorox's digital transformation agenda. The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer helps the business operate faster, smarter, and more efficiently by connecting enterprise systems and automating complex business processes. Through enterprise integrations, APIs, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled solutions, this position directly contributes to productivity improvements, scalability, and innovation across the organisation.

The successful candidate will design, build, and support enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and intelligent automations using UiPath. They will work with business and technology teams to create secure, scalable solutions that connect applications, data, and workflows across functions such as Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, and Operations.

Key areas of focus include:

Building and managing APIs and enterprise integrations
Developing intelligent automation and RPA solutions
Leveraging AI services to enhance business processes
Supporting enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives
Creating reusable assets and frameworks that accelerate future delivery

Key selling points:

Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise transformation initiatives
Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and API-led architectures
Ability to influence how business processes are modernised across a global organisation
Strong cross-functional visibility, partnering with architects, product teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business leaders
Excellent platform for career growth in integration engineering, automation, and AI-driven technology solutions
Opportunity to gain or utilise highly sought-after certifications in MuleSoft and UiPath

This role is a key enabler of Clorox's digital transformation strategy, helping the company become more connected, automated, and AI-enabled. By building enterprise integrations and intelligent automations, the engineer reduces manual effort, improves data flow across systems, accelerates business processes, and enables teams to focus on higher-value work.

The successful hire will:

Drive operational efficiency by automating repetitive processes and eliminating manual handoffs.
Accelerate business transformation through API-led connectivity and intelligent workflow orchestration.
Improve business agility by enabling faster integration of new applications, platforms, and technologies.
Enhance employee productivity through automation and AI-powered solutions.
Strengthen enterprise scalability by creating reusable integration and automation assets that can be leveraged across multiple business functions.
Support AI adoption by connecting enterprise systems and data that serve as the foundation for future AI and agentic capabilities.
Reduce risk and improve reliability through secure, governed, and resilient integration architecture.

What we look for:

This role would suit an engineer with:

3-5+ years of software development, integration, or automation experience
Hands-on expertise with MuleSoft and/or UiPath
Strong API development and integration experience
Experience with cloud and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Azure, or Power Platform
Programming skills in Java, C#, Python, or similar technologies
A passion for automation, AI, and continuous improvement

Workplace type:

Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive.
Learn more
.

Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive:

Competitive compensation
Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international
Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being
Flexible work environment, depending on your role
Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing
Half-day Fridays, depending on your location

Please apply directly to our job postings and do not submit your resume to any person via text message. Clorox does not conduct text-based interviews and encourages you to be cautious of anyone posing as a Clorox recruiter via unsolicited texts during these uncertain times.

To all recruitment agencies: Clorox (and its brand families) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Clorox employees, including any members of our leadership team. Clorox is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Placement Students, Galway.
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Software Engineering Placement Students, Galway.

Placement duration:
January to August 2027

Location:
Galway, Ireland. Onsite throughout the placement.

Build Your Skills. Contribute To Meaningful Work.

At Datavant, we’re working toward a future where every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

As a Software Engineering Intern at our Galway R&D technology centre, you’ll help build products that support healthcare data exchange. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to production features, and see how software engineering principles apply to real-world challenges.

You don’t need to know our full technology stack before joining. We value curiosity, problem-solving skills, strong programming fundamentals, and a willingness to learn. From day one, you’ll take on meaningful work with support from a collaborative team.

What You’ll Do

Help design, develop, and improve production features alongside experienced engineers.
Contribute to scalable applications and data workflows that support healthcare data exchange.
Develop your engineering skills through code reviews, mentorship, and hands-on development.
Collaborate with colleagues across engineering, product, and data teams.
Gain exposure to technologies such as Python, JavaScript, React, AWS, Spark, and Snowflake.

What You’ll Bring

Current enrolment in a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Foundational programming knowledge and experience with at least one modern language, such as Python or JavaScript.
A basic understanding of web development, APIs, or databases gained through coursework, personal projects, or previous internships.
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases is a plus, but is not required
A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced team.
Clear communication skills and a willingness to ask questions, seek feedback, and learn.

What We Offer

Competitive and equitable internship compensation.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced engineers.
Meaningful, hands-on work and exposure to production systems at scale.
A supportive, inclusive environment where you can contribute and grow.

Join Datavant Ireland

Our Galway R&D technology centre tackles complex technology challenges with a clear purpose: helping healthcare data reach the people who need it. We’re looking for interns who want to understand user needs, solve problems, and build a strong foundation in software engineering.

This placement runs from January to August 2027
on a hybrid basis, with two days per week in our Galway office
throughout the internship.

Datavant is committed to building a diverse team and a high-performance culture where everyone belongs and can thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with physical and mental disabilities. Accommodation requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Due to the volume of applications, we will contact only shortlisted candidates.

Thank you for your interest in joining Datavant.

We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavanters who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavanters belong and thrive.

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Datavant is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need an accommodation while seeking employment, please request it here, by selecting the ‘Interview Accommodation Request’ category. You will need your requisition ID when submitting your request, you can find instructions for locating it here. Requests for reasonable accommodations will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

For more information about how we collect and use your data, please review our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Intern, Software Engineer in Test [AEC Autocad Engineering]
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101362

Position Overview

AutoCAD, the leading software for Computer-Aided Design, is seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer in Test intern to join our team to work on the test automation project for AutoCAD Toolset products.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn automation harness and test cases development with AI Tools, software automation process and agile process in software industry while guided by experienced automation developers. You will also learn about Autodesk flagship products: AutoCAD and Toolsets.

On-site in-person recruitment drive starts from 9 October - 6 November 2026

Responsibilities

Understand different automation frameworks
Understand different automation test cases
Create different automation test cases with AI Tools
Use Jenkins pipeline to test the test cases to make sure they are stable
Document the technical details for future reference

Minimum Qualifications

You must be enrolled in a full-time Bachelor's Program in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant fields
You must either be in your penultimate or final year of studies, and will be graduating in 2027 or 2028
Understanding of object-oriented design, data structures and algorithms
Experience of working with languages like C++/C#/Java/Python etc
Self-motivated and eager to learn new technologies
Internship period: 11 January - 25 June 2027 (fixed dates)

Preferred Qualifications

Passion for developing robust software and writing maintainable code
Keen interest in learning new tools and technologies
Experience using AI Tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc)
Flexibility under changing conditions and ability to multi-task between projects
Fluent oral and written communication skills in English language
Self-motivated with positive attitude

Learning Benefits

Hands-on experience with test automation development with AI Tools
Hands-on experience with test automation on Azure environment
Learn best practices in writing and maintaining test automation
Understand the role of test automation in software development process
Exposure to industry leading flagship products in AutoCAD Family

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience, educational level, and geographic location.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.
